messages.author: 515b030b2cb5ea36
messages.subject: Shortcut for indicators in CFA
parts:
In Mplus I could have the syntax:

LATENT by y1-y12;

Is there a comparable way in LAVAAN to shortcut not having to type out all of the y1 thru y 12?

Thanks!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Shortcut for indicators in CFA
parts:
paste0('LATENT =~ y', 1:12)

lavaan accepts a character vector, so the model parameters do not need to be an a single string.
